study.notes: STUDY: LOSE-IT (NCT02905864, Parker Institute, Copenhagen), exploratory secondary analysis of a single centre double blind placebo controlled trial in adults with overweight (BMI 27 or more) and symptomatic knee osteoarthritis: after an 8 week low calorie diet run in with at least 5 percent weight loss, randomised to liraglutide 3 mg daily (dose_mg 3) or placebo for 52 weeks; 156 randomised in the original trial, 63 liraglutide and 60 placebo with samples in Table 3 (n per arm); Table 3 gives changes from week 0 to week 52 per arm as mean (SE) and the group difference with 95 percent CI (route ci_95, MD in the printed units); the exploratory outcomes (CRP, lipids, glucose, HbA1c, eGFR, ALAT, blood pressure) were predefined in a statistical analysis plan for this secondary analysis but are not trial endpoints (prespecified FALSE); baseline values in Table 1 are at enrolment, 8 weeks before randomisation and before a 12.7 kg diet induced weight loss, so no base means are entered (the week 0 values are in the LOSE-IT main report, Gudbergsen 2021, companion pass); weight difference minus 3.8 kg (95 percent CI minus 6.7 to minus 0.9) at 52 weeks, arms minus 4.8 and minus 1.1 kg, week 0 weight not printed so pct_weight_change is left empty (amendment A2); core grant from the Oak Foundation to the Parker Institute, trial drug supplied by Novo Nordisk in the original trial per the main report (industry_funded FALSE for this analysis, see doubts); population knee osteoarthritis with overweight, held under amendment A6; rob_overall some_concerns

json.design: LOSE-IT, single centre double blind placebo controlled trial after a diet run in, liraglutide 3 mg vs placebo, overweight with knee osteoarthritis, 63 and 60 analysed in this secondary analysis, 52 weeks
json.reason: population knee osteoarthritis with overweight, held under amendment A6 (Director decision on held populations); ten inventory markers extracted in full from Table 3 as group differences with 95 percent CI and kept in staging
other_markers: serum NGAL (main outcome of the analysis)

rob.justification: computer generated stratified randomisation with identical placebo (D1 low); participants, investigators and assessors blinded (D2 low); analysis limited to participants with NGAL samples, 123 of 156 randomised, with imputation described for the main analysis (D3 some concerns); laboratory outcomes (D4 low); exploratory outcomes of a secondary analysis with a statistical analysis plan but outside the trial registration (D5 some concerns)

doubts: held population: knee osteoarthritis with overweight (BMI 27 or more); extracted in full, not entered in the master until the Director decides
baseline denominators are not available in this paper (Table 1 is at enrolment before the 8 week diet); the week 0 values are in the LOSE-IT main report (Gudbergsen 2021) for the companion pass
HbA1c is in mmol/mol; conversion to percent is left to the pipeline
industry_funded recorded FALSE for this foundation funded analysis although Novo Nordisk supplied the drug and placebo for the original trial
